technical.summary: Strong ADX trend confirmation exists but is directionally bearish; oversold conditions lack bullish reversal signals and are contradicted by negative momentum, price structure below all key moving averages, and distribution pressure.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 26 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 buys, 1 full sale) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event in 26 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (17/100) and ADX trend confirmation create contrarian opportunity, with price near support (93.93) offering defined risk entry for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish technical structure (price below all moving averages, negative MACD, distribution pressure via CMF), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, earnings in 26 days), and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY) overwhelm oversold conditions lacking bullish reversal confirmation.
